retrievalProfile.description: A centered, symmetrical layout featuring heavy slab-serif typography with deep embossing and metallic textures framed by intricate Victorian-style filigree borders.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured background resembling weathered slate or oxidized metal, containing centered, multi-tiered typography. The text is rendered with a 3D embossed effect, featuring a teal-metallic patina. The entire composition is enclosed in a complex, symmetrical border made of thin parallel lines and ornate scrollwork flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical vertical stacking of text and ornaments
High-contrast texture between smooth embossed letters and grainy background
Framing through concentric linear borders and corner flourishes
Color harmony between dark charcoal and oxidized teal

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally; primary title occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, teal-textured slab serif text in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan starting from the top ornament, through the secondary text, to the primary title, ending at the bottom flourish.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced margins between the border and the central text block.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast on the embossed highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hierarchical scaling of the same typeface family or similar western-style serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic western slab serif aesthetic with spurs.
Provides the ornate, decorative feel suitable for embossing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark charcoal slate texture with a symmetrical Victorian border consisting of thin parallel lines and scrollwork flourishes at the corners and mid-points.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply centered, uppercase slab-serif text with a deep 3D embossed effect, silver highlights on the edges, and a teal-patina texture inside the larger glyphs.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and symmetrical?
Does the embossing have a clear light source/highlight?
Is the border composed of fine lines and flourishes?
Is the background texture visible through the teal patina?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text artifacts or gibberish in the filigree
Verify the 3D effect looks like physical embossing, not just a drop shadow
Check that the teal texture feels integrated into the metal
Confirm the border lines are crisp and parallel
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark Slate Texture + Victorian Filigree Frame + Embossed Western Slab Serif = Classic Americana Aesthetic
